messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and cache_consistency_error spikes in us-east-1. Observed: prefix KV reads falling back to bypass path for ~2% of requests, correlated with increased retries. Pager triggered.

oncall-alex: Acked. I'm up, looking. @sre-jordan can you pull the dashboards?

sre-jordan: Looking now. Heatmap shows sudden jump at 07:42 UTC in prefix-miss rate + a tight fanout from a small set of tenants. CPU on kv-proxy is OK, but backend returns inconsistent reads intermittently.

eng-runtime-leah: We rolled prefetch v2 last night for a subset of model-groups. Possible prefetch/prefix coalescing regression. Recommend fast mitigation: 1) apply soft rate-limit to noisy tenants, 2) disable prefetch for affected model-groups in us-east-1, 3) open bypass path to avoid the problematic KV read path for correctness-sensitive routes.

oncall-alex: Plan accepted. Executing step 1 (soft throttle) now. Will follow with step 2.

infra-ops-ron: I'll stand by to carve temporary quota changes for premium tenants to avoid customer impact once prefetch is disabled.

# executing throttle

oncall-alex: ```bash
# add rate-limit rule for noisy tenants (applies immediately)
curl -X POST 'https://infra.redwood/api/v1/rate-limits' \\ 
  -d 'tenant=t-noisy&limit_per_min=40&reason=prefix-surge-mitigation'
```

cust-success-maya: Notified customers in the affected list. Customer A reported increased retries, Customer B seeing a 10-15% latency bump. I'm prepping a short status message.

eng-runtime-leah: Toggling prefetch off for model-group 'gpt-mini' in us-east-1 now. Command: `redwoodctl feature-set --env=us-east-1 --feature=prefetch=false --model-group=gpt-mini`

infra-ops-ron: Opening a temporary quota carveout for premium tenants to keep them above baseline while prefetch is off: `redwoodctl quota bump --tenant t-premium --tokens-per-min 2000 --ttl 2h`

sre-jordan: Quick metric update: after throttle + toggle, prefix-miss->bypass rate dropped from ~2.0% to 0.45% in 3m. 5xx rate reduced accordingly. Latency for most tenants normalized.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigations applied (throttle + prefetch disable + quota carveout). Continue watch for 30m.

oncall-alex: Leaving short handoff for next oncall (@oncall-nina). Notes: 1) Watch prefix-bypass ratio and 5xx, 2) Keep throttle in place for 1h then evaluate step-down, 3) If errors return, roll back prefetch code from canary. Runbook refs: /runbooks/cache-consistency. Pager duty: remain in channel.

oncall-alex: Handoff -> oncall-nina at 08:00 UTC. Marking manual follow-up: run a request-sampling eval to verify output correctness after bypass.

cust-success-maya: Sending update to customers: "We've applied traffic shaping and disabled an experimental prefetch to mitigate a cache-consistency issue. We expect normal behavior in minutes and will follow up with root cause and timeline." :white_check_mark:

infra-ops-ron: I'll monitor costs and revert quota carveouts once stable.

sre-jordan: Leaving logs + quick diff of KV responses in S3: s3://ops-logs/cache-diffs/3281234567.zip. Recommendation: enable additional sampling on correctness-sensitive tenants for next 2h.

oncall-alex: Closing loop for this thread once 2h stable. If anything regress, re-open and escalate. :eyes:
